description: This file is part of the SuiteCRM project and handles the quick edit functionality for subpanels within the module. It dynamically loads different classes for editing views based on module-specific overrides or default classes, facilitating quick editing of subpanel data.

classes.name: EditViewQuickCreate
classes.description: A class responsible for quick creation editing interface for a module within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: SubpanelQuickEdit
classes.description: A class providing the quick edit functionality for subpanels, allowing inline editing from the subpanel view.

classes.name: Custom{TargetModule}SubpanelQuickEdit
classes.description: A custom override class for subpanel quick edit behavior for specific modules, if present.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the processing of the edit view, rendering appropriate templates or classes.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the HTML for the edit view.
